name: Masainas (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Masainas (a sun on blue above grapes and fruit) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Masainas, a comune in Sardinia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Masainas arms — sun on blue above grapes and fruit, crowned, within branches
